title: Add Gitpod Snapshotter quickstart for RAG lab dev workflows
author: Lian Torres
release_notes: Add Gitpod Snapshotter quickstart to help devs reproduce RAG index state and telemetry locally via cloud workspaces; non-breaking; opt-in example.
description: Motivation: onboarding contributors and customers who iterate on RAG pipelines inside ephemeral cloud dev workspaces is slow because reproducing index state, local telemetry hooks, and dev server config is manual. This quickstart introduces a Gitpod + lightweight snapshotter workflow that captures an index snapshot, attaches minimal telemetry probes, and boots a reproducible dev RAG lab in a single-click cloud workspace. What this PR changes: 1) new example under examples/rag-gitpod-snapshotter/ that includes a tiny seeded index, a snapshot generator script, a shimbed local index server, and example prompt sets for regression tests; 2) Gitpod workspace config and a recommended .gitpod.Dockerfile that pre-installs the index snapshot tooling and the dev agent; 3) a small dev-only telemetry shim (telemetry/debug-probes.md) and smoke test to validate that snapshot generation + dev server boot completes within CI timeouts; 4) docs page added to docs/rag-snapshots.md that describes snapshot semantics, snapshot format, security notes, and how to use snapshots with Redwood Private deployments. Implementation notes: the snapshot format is NDJSON of chunk metadata and signed manifest (no customer data included), snapshotter has a --seed flag to create a deterministic local index for reproducible tests, and workspace config exposes a single startup task (Start RAG Dev Lab) which restores the snapshot and launches the sample dev agent using the redwood-python SDK. Testing: added a CI workflow quickstart-smoke.yml that clones the example, runs the snapshot generator, restores it to the embedded dev index, runs the smoke harness against the dev agent, and asserts deterministic responses for three seeded prompts. Backwards compatibility: feature is opt-in and examples are under examples/, so no runtime change to the platform. Related Linear tickets: ENG-2219 (dev onboarding), ENG-2280 (snapshot format spec).

how_to_try_local: 1) cd examples/rag-gitpod-snapshotter 2) python3 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate 3) pip install -r requirements.txt 4) ./snapshot-generator.py --seed fixtures/seed-corpus.ndjson --out snapshots/sample-snapshot.ndjson 5) ./dev-index-server --load snapshots/sample-snapshot.ndjson 6) python3 run_dev_agent.py --host localhost:8080
